FOLIO_REQUEST_POLICY_REFUSED.summary: {hostLms}'s request policy does not allow a {requestType} request for patron group "{patronGroup}" on this item
nextSteps: In {hostLms}'s FOLIO circulation rules, allow {requestType} requests in the request policy that applies to patron group "{patronGroup}" and this item.
Allow both Page and Hold for every patron group DCB uses: FOLIO pages an available copy, and asks for a Hold once a copy is already paged or on loan.
retrySteps: Retry only once {hostLms}'s staff confirm the request policy now allows {requestType} for patron group "{patronGroup}". Until then a retry is refused in the same way.

To retry this request as it is, consortium staff roll it back from ERROR (POST /patrons/requests/<request id>/rollback, or the rollback action in DCB Admin). DCB places it at {hostLms} again, for the same copy, within a few minutes. The refused attempt placed no hold at {hostLms}, so nothing is duplicated.

To place a new request instead, or to let DCB choose another copy, staff at the borrowing library clean this request up first, then place the new one. Until this request is finished, DCB will not choose the same copy for the same borrowing library again.
FOLIO_REQUEST_POLICY_REFUSED.docs: docs/folio_notes.md, "Request policies for DCB's patron groups"

SIERRA_HOLD_REFUSED_FOR_PATRON_RECORD.summary: {hostLms}'s Sierra refused the hold because of DCB's patron record there (P TYPE {patronType}), not because of the item
nextSteps: In {hostLms}'s Patron Blocks table, compare MAX HOLDS for P TYPE {patronType} with the virtual patron's current hold count, which is in this request's error details, and raise the limit if DCB's requests reach it. Sierra's API cannot override MAX HOLDS.
Check that P TYPE {patronType} may place holds in {hostLms}'s Patron Blocks table for the patron agency DCB's patrons are given.
Check DCB's patron record at {hostLms} for a manual block, an automatic block such as fines over the threshold, or an expiry date in the past, and clear it.
retrySteps: Retry only once {hostLms}'s staff confirm DCB's patron record and the limits for P TYPE {patronType} now allow the hold. Until then a retry is refused in the same way.

To retry this request as it is, consortium staff roll it back from ERROR (POST /patrons/requests/<request id>/rollback, or the rollback action in DCB Admin). DCB places it at {hostLms} again within a few minutes. The refused attempt placed no hold at {hostLms}, so nothing is duplicated.
To place a new request instead, or to let DCB choose another copy, staff at the borrowing library clean this request up first, then place the new one.

ALMA_USER_GROUP_CANNOT_REQUEST.summary: {hostLms}'s Alma does not let user group "{userGroup}" place a hold on this item
nextSteps: In {hostLms}'s Alma fulfillment unit rules that apply to this item, give user group "{userGroup}" a Request term of use that allows a hold. Alma offered this user group: {offered}.
retrySteps: Retry only once {hostLms}'s staff confirm user group "{userGroup}" may now request this item. Until then a retry is refused in the same way.

To retry this request as it is, consortium staff roll it back from ERROR (POST /patrons/requests/<request id>/rollback, or the rollback action in DCB Admin). DCB places it at {hostLms} again within a few minutes. The refused attempt placed no hold at {hostLms}, so nothing is duplicated.
To place a new request instead, or to let DCB choose another copy, staff at the borrowing library clean this request up first, then place the new one.
